_om: Narren in English (Jester, rusj.no/en/jester/): the card game known in Britain as Palace (also Shed). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen legger et tilfeldig kort som pas: The phone plays any card that fits, at random. Good for little ones.
Mobilen legger lavest mulig og sparer to: The phone plays as low as it can and saves its twos and tens for when it needs them.
Mobilen brenner store bunker og stenger: The phone burns big piles and blocks you when you're nearly out. Can you beat it?
You have the lowest card and go first.
{hvem} has the lowest card and goes first.
{hvem} snudde {kort} – og det passet!: {hvem} turned over the {kort} – and it fits!
{hvem} snudde {kort}, som ikke passet, o: {hvem} turned over the {kort}, which didn't fit, and picked up the pile.
The pile burns! You go again.
Spillet sto fast – færrest kort kom best: The game got stuck – the fewest cards came out best.
The pile is empty – play anything.
There's a two on top – play anything.
Sjueren ligger øverst: legg sju eller la: There's a seven on top: play seven or lower.
Only an ace, a two or a ten fits now.
Trykk på et kort på hånda og så på et åp: Tap a card in your hand, then a face-up card, to swap them. Strong cards are good to have face up.
Nå går det blindt: snu ett av de skjulte: Now it's blind: turn over one of your face-down cards.
Nothing fits. You have to pick up the pile.
Hånda er tom – spill fra de åpne kortene: Your hand is empty – play from your face-up cards.
Øverst i bunken ligger {kort}. {antall}: The {kort} is on top of the pile. {antall} in the pile.
Du ble kvitt alle kortene først!: You got rid of all your cards first!
{navn} got rid of their cards first.
Bytt kort – gi mobilen til: Swap cards – pass the phone to
Bli kvitt alle kortene dine – den som si: Get rid of all your cards – whoever is left holding cards at the end is the jester. Everyone gets three cards face down, three face up on top of them and three in their hand.
Legg ett eller flere like kort som er li: Play one or more cards of the same value, equal to or higher than the top card of the pile. Aces are high. While the draw pile lasts, top your hand back up to three cards.
En toer kan legges på alt, og etter den: A two goes on anything, and anything goes on a two. A ten burns the pile: it's out of the game, and you go again. If you can't play, you pick up the whole pile.
Er hånda og trekkbunken tomme, spiller d: When your hand and the draw pile are empty, play your face-up cards, then the face-down ones – blind, one at a time. If a face-down card doesn't fit, you pick up the pile.
Før spillet starter, kan du bytte kort m: Before the game starts, you can swap cards between your hand and your face-up cards. Put strong cards – twos, tens and aces – face up.
Den som har lavest kort på hånda (toere: Whoever has the lowest card in their hand (twos and tens don't count) goes first.
Fire like på rad i bunken brenner den og: Four of a kind in a row burns the pile too. You can switch that rule off.
Husregel «Sjueren»: Etter en sjuer må ne: House rule ‘Sevens’: after a seven, the next player must play seven or lower. Twos and tens always go.
Husregel «Åtteren»: En åtter hopper over: House rule ‘Eights’: an eight skips the next player – one player for each eight.
Den som blir kvitt alle kortene først, v: Whoever gets rid of all their cards first wins. The game goes on until only one player has cards left.
Flere på én mobil: Kortene skjules mello: Several on one phone: the cards are hidden between turns. Tap ‘Show my cards’ when you have the phone.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
Kortene skjules mellom hver tur, så inge: The cards are hidden between turns, so nobody sees anyone else's.
Fire like brenner bunken: Four of a kind burns the pile
Fire like kort på rad i bunken brenner d: Four cards of the same value in a row burn the pile, just like a ten.
Etter en sjuer må neste legge sju eller: After a seven, the next player must play seven or lower.
An eight skips the next player.
Well done! You got rid of your cards first.
Godt kjempa! Neste gang er det mobilens: Good effort! Next time it's the phone's turn.
Du kom på {plass}. plass – og slapp unna: You came in place {plass} – and dodged the jester's hat.
Spill hånda først – de åpne kortene komm: Play your hand first – the face-up cards come after
Du har et kort som passer – legg det: You have a card that fits – play it
Jeg ble kvitt kortene først i Narren ({n: I got rid of my cards first in Jester ({niva}). Can you do the same?
Jeg ble narren i Narren ({niva}). Klarer: I ended up the jester in Jester ({niva}). Can you do better?
Jeg kom på {plass}. plass i Narren ({niv: I came in place {plass} in Jester ({niva}). Can you do better?
{navn} vant Narren, og {narr} ble narren: {navn} won Jester, and {narr} is the jester! Have a go yourself.
{navn} won Jester! Have a go yourself.
Spillet blir ikke ferdig, og ingen blir: The game won't be finished, and nobody is the jester this time.
